name: stop-slop
title_zh: 删掉「值得注意的是」的 AI 腔校对员
tagline_zh: 投稿前过一遍，把「此外」「总之」「不仅…而且」这类 AI 惯用语连根拔起。不重写你的观点，只刮掉那层塑料味。
tagline_en: Run drafts through it before submitting: it yanks out 'Moreover,' 'In conclusion,' and other AI tics. Keeps your.
desc_en: Remove AI writing patterns from prose. Use when drafting, editing, or reviewing text to eliminate predictable AI tells.
why_zh: 不是查重，是查「AI 指纹」：它认得 ChatGPT/Claude 最爱用的连接词和句式骨架。
why_en: Not plagiarism check—fingerprint check. It knows the connective tissue and sentence skeletons LLMs favor, excises those, leaves.
limit_zh: 只处理英文文本；中文、代码、诗歌不在服务范围。它删的是模式化措辞，不负责改写逻辑或提升文采——原文若本就空洞。
limit_en: English prose only; no Chinese, code, or poetry. It strips formulaic phrasing, not logic or style—if the original is hollow, it'll just look barer.
